nodes.label: Tapas Icon 1 SVG
nodes.description: A simple SVG icon depicting a wine glass or cocktail glass silhouette. It consists of two golden/dark yellow (#B8860B) filled paths: the top path forms a trapezoidal bowl shape (the cup portion of a glass) and the bottom path forms a stem and base. The icon is 100x100 viewBox, minimalist in style, likely used as a decorative tapas/drinks menu icon.
